Both program-list pages are business-school pages: Penn State Smeal Management & Organization PhD placements 2009-2014 (names, year, employer, position; one entry is a posthumous PhD with no employer) and Ohio State Fisher Management Sciences job-market candidates (two names, no placements). Two Technion saved texts do not match the candidate URL: the Advisors.asp?Key=19697 file is a capture of Key=19652, and the facultytheses degree=2&fac=9 file is a capture of Fac=20&Degree=3; the review reflects the saved text. The Technion graduate-school thesis database (grad/graduate.technion.ac.il/Theses/FacultyTheses.asp) lists PhD and MSc theses by department with names and graduation years, so the Industrial Engineering and Management faculty's Degree=3 page would be worth a targeted look if not already captured.
